notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.2 : Fancy Update (Part 3)
notes.notes:
[p](September 15th 2025)[/p][p][/p][p]I've heard you loud and clear. Everybody wants a better world map. The world is too blocky! I get it.[/p][p][/p][p]This will be the last "Fancy Update". The next update is the big one. Don't expect it for a couple of months but I will make sure the wait is worth it. But that's next update. Here is what I've been working on these past 2 months (Other than playing silksong).

The focus of this update was to make skills look and feel more unique from one another by adding sounds and animations. I also reworked breeding to be less of a chore.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Tulpa[/b] : Added 8 new evolutions. (Every tulpa evolves now).[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tulpa[/b] : Most tulpas learn new and improved skills. (Cubble no longer learns a skill that regenerate mana, but no skill that uses mana)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tulpa[/b] : Bunibble's new evolution comes in 3 unique forms. (The forms are purely aesthetic)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tulpa[/b] : Bunibble was changed to come in 3 colors by default.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Tulpa[/b] : Some descriptions in the bestiary were improved.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Skills now have different sound effects and a few animations. (punching, throwing, dancing, etc.)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Status effects now have unique visual effects and sounds.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Added the status effects "snare" and "shackle" which prevent the target from moving.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Added the status effect "Elemental shield" which will add temporary health of a certain element, regardless of the tulpa's actual element.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Slightly decreased stutter during battle.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Added a summon/retrieve animation that also plays when you set your follower.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : Added the "wake up" and "element chart" buttons from battle to the formation screen. (You can now give up before the battle even starts)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle[/b] : A tulpa's tooltip will now appear when you summon. (So you don't accidentally summon a tulpa with 1 HP)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Breeding[/b] : Eggs are now items and will hatch based on time, not battles fought.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Breeding[/b] : Added an animation when eggs hatch.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b] : Added an inventory screen. (The only available items are eggs)[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b] : Added a counter to keep track of elements unlocked in the element chart[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b] : Added a counter to keep track of tulpas caught in the bestiary.[/p][/*][*][p][b]UI[/b] : Added the last elemental background. (Light)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld[/b] : The exclamation mark above wild tulpas who spot you is made of cardboard and makes a sound.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld[/b] : Tulpas in later levels will now spawn as their evolved form, making later levels more difficult.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld[/b] : Wild tulpas are now guaranteed to spawn with skills that do damage and will priorities skills that don't cost mana to prevent battles where nothing happens.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld[/b] : Moved the dresser to the apartment to be easier to access. (It is no longer a reward for finding keys)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Overworld[/b] : Moved the breeding CD to be easier to access.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Achievement[/b] : The achievement for hatching 100 eggs should trigger correctly now.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Achievement[/b] : Changed the achievement for "having a powerlevel of over 9000" to the trainer being level 100 instead.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Lighting[/b] : Fixed a bug where the lighting would be wrongly affected by the room you are in during certain animations such as evolution.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.1.1 : Fancy Update (Quick Fix)
notes.notes: [p](July 21th 2025)[/p][p][/p][p]There were a few bugs that snuck in the last update. This quick fix addresses all the ones that were reported.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Balance : Tulpas in the reserve now get 25% of the experience even if they were not summoned.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance : Tulpas regenerate 2% of their max mana every turn.[/p][/*][*][p]Balance : Everytime you fail a catch, the catch chance increases by a small amount (Up to 33%).[/p][/*][*][p]UI : You can now check the tooltip of monsters in the formation screen.[/p][/*][*][p]World : Beds are now useable in the dream world and will simply wake you up.[/p][/*][*][p]World : CDs now give a popup telling you the name of the CD you just collected.[/p][/*][*][p]World : After some feedback, I removed the green light from the blue room (This sentence makes sense in context).[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed : Some skills were not checking the correct values when deciding if you could afford them. Sting in particular allowed you to kill yourself by using it.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed : Tooltips in the breeding menu would show all stats as 0 if the tulpa had the passive Hivemind.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed : The chef's uniform did not render and in some cases made you a floating head.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.8.1 : Fancy Update (Part 2)
notes.notes: [p](July 16th 2025)[/p][p][/p][p]This update focuses on adding passives and skills to all tulpas to differentiate them more from eachothers. There are still missing features I want to add such as placing mines and walls, but this is a big step forward. To compensate for the lack of new tulpas last update, I added 6 tulpas instead of the usual 3. I hope you enjoy this new version.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]ADDITIONS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Tulpa : Added 6 new evolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Tulpa : Added 14 new passives.[/p][/*][*][p]Tulpa : Added a massive amount of new skills.[/p][/*][*][p]World : Added a ton of new NPCs to fight.[/p][/*][*][p]World : Added more objects and images to the world to make it feel less empty.[/p][/*][*][p]World : Added particle effects to certain zones for the atmosphere.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Added 2 new elemental backgrounds.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Added notifications when you unlock new clothes or new skills.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Added new status effects such as Frostbite, Mark, Snare and more.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p]UI : Improved the evolution animation.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Improved nearly every species' description.[/p][/*][*][p]UI : Made some tooltips more readable.[/p][/*][*][p]AI : Enemies will now use status effect skills and heals.[/p][/*][*][p]AI : Tulpas are guaranteed to spawn with at least 1 damaging skill equipped, including starters.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]World : Tulpas will no longer chase you once your trainer is a certain level above them.[/p][/*][*][p]World : Moved the breeding CD and dresser around to be less tedious to find for new players.[/p][/*][*][p]World : One of the secret worlds spawn lampicks instead of snoofs now.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Trainers can only put 3 tulpas on the field at the same time.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Movement and skills now uses different points that you get at the beginning of your turn allowing you to move, attack and then move again in some cases.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Using summon and retrieve no longer ends your turn (or use a skill point).[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Rebalanced every tulpa's stats to be less homogenous.[/p][/*][*][p]Battle : Rebalanced some elements, notably Insect to be less boring and weak.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]BUG FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fixed : Crash that would happen if you hovered the mouse over portraits while summoning.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed : Bug where bosses would fail to spawn sometimes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed : Bug where holding the camera and entering the PC at the same time softlocked you.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed : Bug where trainers would be missing when you challenge them again but not give up when you kill their last tulpa, softlocking you in battle.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.7.5
notes.notes:
[May 11th 2025]

Here is another update just in time for Steam's Creature Collector Fest tomorrow. This update also focuses on improving battles. Specifically, making battles easier to understand. This will probably be the last "Battle Update" but battles will keep improving little by little every update. My plan is to add around 3 evolutions per update on average.

[b]BALANCE[/b]
- Gave Myskit a passive called "Oracle".
- Added 3 new evolutions for Beeble, Cubble and Beasel.
- Balanced Beeble, Cubble and Beasel's skills (weaker starting skills, stronger skills after evolving).
- Added various new skills such as "Wind Slap", "Push" and "After-image".
- Reduced dodge chance significantly.
- Renamed "Immobile" to "Stubborn".

[b]CHANGES[/b]
- UI : Redesigned the summary and bestiary screens.
- UI : Added tooltips to the bank and breeding screens.
- UI : Added tooltips to passives and skills so you know what they do.
- UI : Added an indicator to new things when they are added to your bestiary.
- UI : Inverted right and left click on tulpa portraits.
- BATTLE : Redesigned the entire battle arena and how things are rendered.
- BATTLE : You can now see the miss chance, health and mana of whatever you are attacking.
- BATTLE : The entire range of your attacks are now shown as dark tiles.
- BATTLE : It is now more obvious whose turn it is.
- BATTLE : Improved animations so tulpas face eachother while they attack one another.
- BATTLE : Status effects now have animations.
- BATTLE : Buffs now stack up to 3 times.
- BATTLE : Stats that are buffed will render as higher (and green) in the tulpa's tooltip.
- TEXTURE : Improved the textures of some tulpas (Especially Nyarn's yarn ball).
- CONTROLLER : Improved the feel of controller support in battle.
- ??? : Made several colors brighter (Element colors, UI elements, etc.).

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- Fixed a bug where your own tulpas dying gave you experience.
- Fixed a bug where the experience bar would show 1 frame of being the wrong level sometimes.
- Fixed a bug where controller support would break during the tutorial's final fight.
- Fixed a bug where cubble's passive would steal nearby buffs and heals.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.7.4
notes.notes:
[May 1st 2025]

On may 12th, Steam's Creature Collector Fest will begin. For this occasion, I've been preparing this version of Dream Catcher which focuses on making combat more fun. I hope you all enjoy it.

[b]CHANGES[/b]
- VISUAL : All tulpa textures have been remade to have a more consistent angles, shadows and outlines.
- VISUAL : Greatly improved attack animations (Still pretty rudimentary).
- BATTLE : Tulpa will now dodge attacks based on how much agility/precision is involved.
- BATTLE : Complete overhaul of the skill system.
- BATTLE : Some skills now use mana/health as resource.
- BATTLE : Added status effects (Fire, Poison, Bleed) and stat buffs.
- BATTLE : Added passive abilities to certain tulpas.
- BATTLE : The element chart can be accessed during battle.
- BATTLE : Renamed "Give Up" to "Wake Up" to make it clear what will happen if you click.
- INTERFACE : Newly gained experience renders as yellow to see the difference easier.
- INTERFACE : When a tulpa levels up, its level will render as green to signify it changed.
- INTERFACE : You can see a tulpa's experience bar in their summary.
- INTERFACE : Added numerous tooltips to various UI elements (Ex: tulpa names in the bank).
- Added (some) evolutions.
- BALANCE : Made the main character's default light radius brighter so light tulpas are not as necessary.
- BALANCE : Reduced terracute's agility because a clay pot should not dodge this much.
- BALANCE : Catching a tulpa will now reward you with experience.
- BALANCE : Increased the experience you need to level up a little bit (Sharper curve).
- BALANCE : Previously, the stats you get each level was reduced to accentuate strategy over grinding. Stats have been increased so levels matter again, but are still lower than they used to be.
- BALANCE : Increased the trainer's defense early-game but doesn't increase quite as much each level.

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- BATTLE : Fixed a bug where the enemies could use all of their skills, not just their equipped ones.
- BATTLE : Fixed a bug where you could summon dead tulpas with 0 health.
- BATTLE : Fixed a bug where pulling a draw would not wake you up and let you walk around with 0 health.
- INTERFACE : Fixed a bug where eggs could fly.
- INTERFACE : Fixed a bug where you could get additional egg info by checking their tooltip in the breeding app.
- SAVE FILES : Savefiles from the very first version of the game can now be opened again.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.7.3
notes.notes:
[April 8th 2025]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
- Changed the name of multiple tulpas.
- Changed the texture of multiple tulpas.
- Some monsters had their colors tweaked to be less dull and desaturated.
- Stats are now smaller for readability.
- Stats also increase less per level to priorities strategy over grinding.
- Added a new stat called "Precision" that will act as agility (strength for ranged attacks) but also increase  the chance of hitting attacks, Agility will now increase dodge chance instead (Dodge is not yet implemented).
- the Charisma stat was made invisible because it had no purpose (The stat is not deleted and will be implemented later).
- Eggs now take a set amount of victories to hatch instead of experience.
- Tulpas now come in 18 sizes instead of the previous 7.

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- GRAPHICS : Improved glow on some objects like the sun.
- GAMEPLAY : Added buttons to summon and retrieve tulpas during battle.
- UI : Improved slightly the conclusion, bestiary and summary screens.
- UI : Improved slightly multiple tooltips throughout the game.
- AI : Enemy trainers will now surrender if their entire team is dead.
- AI : Enemies will never heal when on full health, even if they have nothing else to do.

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- Fixed multiple bugs in the enemy AI (Ex: enemies will not skip their turn when there is nowhere to walk anymore).
- Fixed controller support which was broken last update.
- Fixed a bug where leveling did not increase your health to maintain your health to max health ratio.
- Fixed a bug where the summary wouldn't update a monster's size if monsters were identical in every other way but size.
- Fixed a bug where old savefiles would fail to convert to the new format if you skipped multiple updates. Now you can open savefiles from years ago.
- Fixed a visual glitch where lighting would flicker when you unpause the game if the camera was rotated inbetween pausing and unpausing.
- Fixed a bug where the camera was too zoomed in during your first battle.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.7.2.1
notes.notes:
[March 6th 2025]

[b]REBALANCE[/b]
- Made your starter have a 100% catchrate.
- Almost tripled the amount of experience you get.

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- Fixed a bug where newly caught monsters said they were caught by "Unknown".
- Fixed a bug where catchrate was backward (The lower their health the harder to catch they were).

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.7.2
notes.notes:
[March 5th 2025]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
- Trainers can now be attacked (Dying ends the battle).
- Trainers can now gain experience and level up.
- You can now start a battle with no tulpa equipped (The trainer cannot be unequipped).
- Experience is now shared more fairly toward the tulpas who participate the most.
- Units can now move 2 tiles per turn (Does not end the turn).
- Improved the battle grid.
- All skill area of effects are now relative to the caster.
- Added an animation for when catching fails.
- Drastically improved the enemy AI (They will priorities attacking your trainer and won't heal when full health anymore).

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- FIxed a crash that would happen when using a healing skill.
- Fixed a bug where beating the tutorial didn't set your skin to the default colors.
- Fixed a bug where catching never failed.
- Fixed a bug where the window would appear at weird locations on startup (Or at least it happens less often).
- Fixed a visual bug that caused the floor to render over certain particles.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.7.1
notes.notes:
[February 13th 2025]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
- Improved the quality of monster icons.
- Changed the name of Bibli to Cherubaby.
- Added health and mana bars on battle tooltips.
- Added the ability to move to a different tile during battle.

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- Fixed Cherubaby's size and offset.
- Fixed a crash that would happen when you give up during the starter fight.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.7
notes.notes:
[February 3rd 2025]

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- Redesigned the battle interface.
- You can now click on the timeline portraits to target a tulpa.
- Made it more clear that "Capture" happens on the trainer's turn.
- Improved the glow effect on tulpas' eyes.
- Improved ALL tulpa textures (lineart, colors, shading. Everything is better).
- Improved ALL battle animations.
- Made controller support in battle slightly less finicky.
- Improved the screenshot function (Tulpas appear more as they do in-game when you save to PNG).
- Added an insect-type background (Thanks to Gij).
- Added a water-type background (Thanks to Gij).
- Improved how elemental backgrounds render to be less pixelated at low resolutions.
- Made some battle arenas bigger so it doesn't look like the trainer is perpetually balancing on the edge.
- Hovering the mouse over a portrait during battle will highlight that tulpa.
- The first tulpa you catch in the tutorial is automatically set as your follower.

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- You can look at tulpas' stats while in aiming mode.
- Improved how reliable it is to load unknown or impossible tulpas and renders a question mark instead.
- Fixed an uncommon bug where some monsters would glow as if they were being captured in the overworld.
- Removed a lot of Z-fighting in battle (The floor grid would flicker sometimes).
- Fixed a bug where tulpas would take 1 frame to rotate toward the camera during battle animations.

These issues were considered not large enough to prevent an update and will be fixed next patch.
[b]KNOWN ISSUES[/b]
- Catching has a 100% chance of succeeding regardless of a tulpa's health.
- You cannot view a tulpa's health except on its own turn.
- Turned off all barking sounds while I work on better sound effects (Only affects Empurr and Woolectric).
- The wind, light and psychic backgrounds are still placeholder textures.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.6.1
notes.notes:
[November 20th 2024]

[b]CHANGES[/b]
- Added full controller support (was previously partial support).
- Added a keybind for "sneaking" (shift by default).
- Added a keybind for "camera grab" (right click by default).
- The camera is no longer paused when the game is paused so you can look around.
- Tulpas in battle will no longer overlap even if they are larger than their square.
- Added temporary camera movements and battle animations.
- Healthbars are now more visible and less finicky.
- The new catching animation should make it easier to see how catching works.

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- Fixed a bug where saving a tulpa to png before it was done loading would crash the game.
- Fixed a graphical glitch that would make some tulpas (beeble) look bad when saved to a png.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.6.0.2
notes.notes:
[October 15th 2024]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- Fixed a bug that allowed you to duplicate or overwrite existing monsters in your monster bank.
- Fixed a bug where the girl's changing room floor would be the wrong texture (for real this time).
- Fixed a bug where the follower would remain after a battle where it died even though you cannot have a dead tulpa as your follower normally.

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- Mildly improved the formation screen before a battle.
- Added a small animation and sound effect that plays when a door is unlocked.
- Added sparkles to collectibles.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.6.0.1
notes.notes:
[October 12th 2024]

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- Fixed the character's colors being white by default despite having completed the tutorial sometimes.
- Fixed a bug where the girl's changing room floor would be the wrong texture on some machines.
- Fixed a bug where capturing a monster before you open the computer for the first time would create a new unnecessary box.
- Fixed a bug where the character enters a new room or wakes up with some built-up momentum.

[b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- The "description" section of the monster summary now has a readable location name instead of nonsense like "W4/TROOM_1".

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.6
notes.notes:
[October 11th 2024]

This is easily the biggest update to date. Most of the changes are graphical but there are a few quality of life improvements.

[b]BIG IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- Monsters are now made of proper god-fearing cardboard.
- The monster portraits in the bestiary and summary screens are now animated and showcase the real size of monsters.
- Added the ability to tilt the camera temporarily by holding right click, Letting go of right click will make the camera gravitate back to the default position.
- Added a proper skybox with clouds and asters to go with the new ability to see the sky.
- Made a brand new tutorial with much better graphics.
- Improved the light effect of some followers.
- Added a light effect to more monsters when they follow you (Pupkin and Clunker).
[b]SMALL IMPROVEMENTS[/b]
- Eggs render less pixelated.
- Increased the speed at which textures load.
- Added an option to turn off shadows (Can increase the framerate by up to 15% on some machines).
- Added an option for mouse sensitivity (Only affects the speed of the camera).
- Improved the scale, rotation and offset of various monsters and monster icons.
- Improved the general quality of most textures.
- Slightly improved the quality of shadows in general.
- Collectibles look better (They rotate and look like what they are supposed to be).

[b]BUG FIXES[/b]
- Fixed a bug that would cause monsters to be duplicated when captured in some cases.
- Fixed a bug that let you catch 2 starters when they were too close together.
- Door highlights no longer render above the main character.
- Fixed all memory leaks.
- FIxed a bug where the lighting would get much worse at random intervals for no reason.
- There were multiple ways to make monsters appear for 1 frame before being replaced with another, these types of bugs have all been removed.

[b]FIXED REGRESSIONS[/b]
- Re-added the slippery physics in the ice cave in Mint Mountain.
- Characters are now the correct colors in the save select screen instead of just grey.
- Fixed a bug that caused monsters to never be a recolor introduced in the previous update.
[b]ADDED REGRESSIONS[/b]
- Temporarily turned off the rain in Sakura Shore and snow in Mint Mountain. These effects will be replaced by a proper weather system later.

notes.title: Dream Catcher 1.5
notes.notes:
[June 23rd 2024]

For multiple months I've been porting the game to a new engine. I thought this was a good opportunity to fix a lot of issues that were happening under-the-hood since I would have to basically remake the entire game from scratch. This ended up taking much longer than I thought (Longer than the original game took to make). Sorry for the update drought but things are back in order, albeit with a few regressions. Expect more consistent updates going forward.

[b]THE GOOD[/b]

- Fixed a common crash that made the game basically unplayable for certain computers.
- The game launches dozens of times faster.
- The game should use immensely less RAM and GPU RAM.
- Monsters look much better in general (No more color artifacts, weird pixelization, etc).
- In the overworld, the rarest monster (Ex: recolors) will be used as the visible member of the group.
- Breeding now produces an egg instead of a baby. The egg requires experience to hatch.
- Machines such as breeding are no longer objects. Instead, they are CDs you collect that add their functionality to your computer.
- Recolors can now be black and white. Two colors that were previously impossible in most species.
- All UI have been improved.
- Removed STAB. Every skill a monster learns performs at 100% power.
- Monsters now have 4 tiers of evolutions instead of 3 and most evolution lines changed.
- Controller support is 90% complete.
- You can now add more PC Boxes, making the amount of monsters you can catch functionally infinite.
- Added a screenshot button to save your monsters with a transparent background.
- Added various tooltips that explain what does what.
- Added arrows to summary and bestiary for quicker navigation.
- Monsters can now have shaders on selective parts of their bodies (Ex: Glowing eyes).
- Added an insect element for balancing reasons. This mean there are less normal-type monsters and skills.
- Monsters won't despawn when you change room anymore. They won't respawn until you wake up either.
- Added a small tutorial with the first ever trainer battle.
- Renamed skills to make it clear they are placeholders.
- Added a heal spell.
- The player is now allowed to have an empty team but entering a battle will instantly result in a loss.
- Changed the experience curve to be less grindy in some cases but harder to rush a level 1 to level 40 in 2 battles.
- Added the ability to customize the computer.
- Added backgrounds to the monster summary/bestiary.
- Reworked every species to have a more uniform baby form.
- The element chart now slowly unveil as you try different combinations.
- Changed the highlight of objects so they glow various colors instead of just having a prompt above them.
- Removed the system where you'd unlock skills the more you used skills of the same element. Unlocking skills will be simpler going forward.
- If you are surrounded by multiple monsters when you get attacked, they will all join the battle as 1 massive group.
- Improved the character controls.
- Replaced the sprinting stamina bar with a sneaking ability instead.
- The breeding machine is no longer a machine. Instead, once you collect the CD, the functionality is added to your computer.
- Other uncountable small bug fixes and slight improvements.

[b]THE BAD[/b]

- Disabled character customization while I add the new costume system. Everyone will appear as grey.
- Disabled evolutions while monsters are being reworked and re-added.
- All monsters from old savefiles will be converted to level 1 eggs of their species.
- Certain species like Wizmo and Retro Terracute have been removed and will be transformed into new equivalent species instead. Booble will also be converted to Beeble as it is the evil version of Beeble and not a seperate species anymore.
- Disabled overworld monster behavior such as running away from the player if they are higher level, will re-add later.
- Battles are improved in some ways and regressed in others (Ex: skills don't use mana, some stats do nothing yet, status effects have not been ported, formation doesn't matter, etc.).
- Certain machines have not been ported yet such as the Rebirth Machine.
- Achievements don't work anymore but it hardly matters because I will replace them with different achievements down the line.

[b]CONCLUSION[/b]

Even if some regressions happened, I believe it is important to upload an update just so people finally stop crashing. The next few updates will focus on removing regressions. The biggest regression is obviously the lack of evolutions but I think it's more important to rework the evolution lines and give them unique skills.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43591158/6f47fd784ae480f5342e4f069ac0b201c85f2811.gif[/img]

notes.title: Dream Catcher Roadmap
notes.notes:
[March 31st 2024]

It's been a while since I last updated the game and I thought I would keep you updated on what's going on. The game is still being worked on but moving engine was a much bigger endeavor than I originally thought, but there is light at the end of the tunnel. A large percentage of the game has been improved during the porting process.

[b]1. WHAT CHANGED?[/b]

The new engine uses memory more efficiently so expect reductions in RAM usage, higher FPS, etc. But that's not very interesting so here is a curated list of changes that have already been finished.

- Monsters look much better in general (No more color artifacts, weird pixelization, etc).
- In the overworld, the rarest monster (Ex: recolors) will be used as the visible member of the group.
- Breeding now produces an egg instead of a baby. The egg requires experience to hatch.
- Machines such as breeding are no longer objects. Instead, they are CDs you collect that add their functionality to your computer.
- Recolors can now be black and white. Two colors that were previously impossible in most species.
- All UI have been improved.
- For logistic reasons you now have to "confirm" your formation before each battle. It does save your previous settings though.
- Removed STAB. Every move a monster learns performs at 100% of its power.
- Every moves (now named skills) have been reworked and every monster has a different moveset.
- Monsters now have 4 tiers of evolutions instead of 3 and most evolution lines changed.
- Various bug fixes.

[b]2. WHAT'S NEW?[/b]

While I was working on changing engine, I couldn't help myself from adding new features. Here are a few that are ready to go.

- Controller support.
- You can now add more PC Boxes, making the amount of monsters you can catch functionally infinite.
- In the overworld, the "power level" of a group appears above their head.
- Added a screenshot button to save your monsters with a transparent background.
- Added various tooltips that explain what does what.
- Added arrows to summary and bestiary for quicker navigation.
- Monsters can now be semi transparent and have animated parts such as fire tails.
- The eyes of monsters will not be affected by lighting such that their eyes glow in the dark.
- Monsters can now wear hats.
- Added an insect element for balancing reasons. This does mean there are less normal type moves and monsters though.

[b]3. WHAT'S TO COME?[/b]

The main reason I haven't posted an update yet is I don't want to upload a version of the game that is smaller than the previous one. To speed things along, I think It's worth it to port all the old maps and slowly patch in the new world room by room in later updates. This means the next update won't have any new zones but I think It's worth it to have regular updates again. I'm also trying to convert all the old savefiles as best I can but a lot of things have changed and It's not always obvious what to do (Ex: The experience curve to level up changed, All monsters now learn different skills, etc.). Here is a curated list of things I am currently working on.

- Multiple passives for each species.
- Monsters won't despawn when you change room anymore. They won't respawn until you wake up either.
- Improved tutorial.
- Improved battles (Where strategy actually matters).
- A map that slowly fills in as you explore the world.
- Simple placeholder animations in battle (Ex: camera moving around, particle effects, healthbars going down, etc).

[b]4. LONG TERM GOALS[/b]

I made a roadmap of all the major features I want to add in the long run. I have no idea when they are coming out or if they are coming out in this order.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43591158/56e6efecb297157390dcb53baab0d7dfb6bbfc55.png[/img]

notes.title: Dream Catcher v1.4.4
notes.notes:
September 27th 2023

[u][b](Experimental branch only):[/b][/u]
[b]GENERAL:[/b]
- Changed the way damage indicators in battle work under-the-hood in an attempt to reduce crashes (How this turns out will depend massively on your computer).
[b]TERRAIN:[/b]
- Added a monster found in Rocky Road.
- Added a boss that blocks the way in Rocky Road.
- Improved Rocky Road a lot (Still pretty rough).
- Added a small room where Velvet Valley will be just so you can't soft-lock yourself by picking the fire starter (You can grind a bit and catch a few monsters).
[b]NOTES:[/b]
This is a smaller update that only affects users of the experimental branch. In case you didn't know, everyone can opt-in the experimental branch and try it out. Your save-file won't be corrupted and you can always turn back.



In other news, I'm heavily considering changing engine which would be a massive undertaking that might take upward of a month to complete. I'm still thinking about it but I don't think I can improve the game as fast as I want unless I fix the core of the game first. This would allow me to reintroduce old features that broke along the way such as the language option and controller support.

Another thing that changed is my attitude toward game development. Earlier in development, there were a lot of concept art used as placeholder for monsters and very rough textures and maps. Monsters sometimes come out with only 1 evolution and lacking move-pools. I've been pushing a lot to have all the art finalized and the map look good in the past few months. I came to the conclusion I should rework every single monster to have complete art and complete move-pools and not add new monsters until they are ready as well. HOWEVER, after hitting my head on my desk for 2 months I don't think It's productive to complete each zones of the map one by one and only releasing finished ones. If you have been playing on anything but the experimental branch of the game you probably noticed a lack of updates, this is why. Going forward, I will add much more blocky and basic maps that will later on be filled with monsters and final graphics just to test distances and questlines. I simply encourage people not go to clearly unfinished maps, maybe I will make it clear which zones are unfinished with some sort of UI element. Either way, I think only releasing completely finished monsters but rough maps is the best path forward.

[b]TL;DR:[/b]
- Might go on hiatus for a month or two while I move engine.
- If I do go on hiatus, expect a huge upgrade to everything (but the game might not run on older PCs)
- Language selection and Controller support coming back (probably, eventually).
- Every monster will be reworked to have finalized art and a decent, more unique move-pool.
- New monsters won't release until they are finalized, even if that leaves certain zones rather empty.
- New maps will come out faster and with unfinished graphics, but in exchange they should come out faster and multiple zones should be added simultaneously.

notes.title: Dream Catcher v1.4.1
notes.notes:
Today, September 3rd 2023, The way the legacy branch works has changed.

First of all, the legacy branch is now the default branch. instead, the new map was moved to the experimental branch which is now public for anyone to try. Savefiles should be compatible back and forth but you should still backup your savefiles before trying the experimental branch. To achieve this, both the legacy and experimental builds of the game were updated.

IMPROVEMENTS (Legacy):
- Added two new monsters that are only catchable in the experimental branch.
- Added default values for unknown monsters so that future updates do not corrupt your savefile.

IMPROVEMENTS (Experimental):
- Added two new monsters.
- Added default values for unknown monsters for future proofing.
- Added a boss to Rocky Road.
- Multiple different monsters will spawn in the same areas with different rarities.
- Some monsters will only spawn after a boss was defeated to not crowd boss areas.
- Removed prompts in the item menu that made it seem like you could move your team and open their summary when you couldn't.
- CONTROLS : Right-click now properly captures the mouse.
- GRAPHICS : Added a breathing animation on the player character.
- GRAPHICS : All entities should look better regardless of camera angle.
- GRAPHICS : All entities were too dark 75% of the time so I changed the lighting system.
BUG FIX (Experimental):
- Fixed a bug where going in a straight line would cause the character and/or follower to look side to side sometimes.
- Fixed a bug that would cause you to get softlocked when opening your team or item tab while your team was too full (Caused by the team limit being reduced between versions).

Thank you for your patience as I continue to work on Rocky Road.

notes.title: Dream Catcher v1.4
notes.notes:
Today, August 30th 2023, A new update was released that significantly changes the world and how you explore it.

IMPROVEMENTS:
- Enemy pathfinding is more reliable.
- Enemy spawning is less random (AKA a room won't be empty or full once in a while).
- Added footstep sounds based on what you are walking on.
- Majorly overhauled how maps are designed.
- Battle arenas change a lot more from room to room.
- The tutorial is a lot shorter.
- The camera can now be controlled by the player by holding right-click.
- Shadows are a lot more consistent.
- Falling off the map now teleports you back to the door you entered from instead of waking you up.
- Made sprinting about 75% faster and it lasts longer to compensate for bigger zones.
- Streamlined the waking up/going to bed cycle to be less confusing.
- Fixed a bug where breeding a new monster wouldn't add it to your bestiary.
- Ground textures look a LOT better and have normal maps (especially in Rocky Road)
- Added the feedback button to the crash screen so you can send us error reports easier.

NOTES:
- If you preferred the game as it was you can go in Steam's Beta feature and select "Legacy" as your branch. Right now, save files should be compatible with both versions of the game but this might change as the newer versions of the game keep changing. Please backup your saves when you switch between the two versions.
- All your teddy bears will reset as the system to unlock more team slots has changed (Doesn't apply to the legacy branch).
- If you play the new game with a team of more than 1 monster, you will be soft-locked upon opening Team. To prevent this, you can simply open the PC first and adjust your team to match your new team size limit.
- Not all monsters that are in the legacy branch are available in the new version. New zones and monsters (as well as improved old ones) will be added periodically.

THE FUTURE:
The goal is to add 1 zone a month but the next month will be used to improve Rocky Road. When a zone comes out, it should be complete and contain at lest 3 unique monsters. Old monsters will return periodically with new art, movesets and stats. maybe new evolutions.

notes.title: Dream Catcher: Discount and Progress Report
notes.notes:
DISCOUNT:
Dream Catcher came out a month ago and as a result was not able to participate in the summer sales. However, here is the next best thing. Dream Catcher will be 10% off until August 23rd (About 2 weeks).

PROGRESS:
Some eagle eyed readers might have noticed there hasn't been an update in a while. This is because I've been working on redoing the entire way terrain is rendered and loaded. The original plan was to update at the beginning of the sale but this proved to be a much bigger update than i thought and it is still not ready and probably won't be ready before the sale ends. Another thing, the next update will have the new terrain loading and rendering but the world map will still not be finalized. The plan is to release an update that looks and plays about as good as the current version with a map about the same size AND THEN start doing regular updates again, patching in a new zone every now and then. Note that not every currently available monsters will be available right away after the next update, but your current team should not be affected.

WHAT HAS ALREADY BEEN DONE:
- Fog, lighting and shadows are a lot more consistent.
- New maps have trigger points that allow for more interesting puzzles.
- Objects are no longer locked to the grid (In fact the new maps are no longer grid-based)
- There are now different types of cameras for different kinds of maps. So expect more dynamic camera angles.
- Your camera zoom level is now saved so you don't have to keep scrolling all the way out every time you start the game.
- Battle arenas now have an actual unique 3D model based on the zone you are in. They are no longer just different textures for the same sumo wrestling circle.
- Monsters spawn a lot more consistently and won't result in rooms being sometimes empty and sometimes completely full.

WHAT IS LEFT TO DO:
- Fix some pathfinding issues related to the new system that allows for slopes and irregular shapes.
- Fix some rendering issues related to the new way monsters are rendered (You probably won't see a difference but it was necessary to change for the new shadows and cameras).
- Improve your follower to not get stuck on slopes and other similar issues.
- Make a map that is at least as large as the current one.
- Fix bugs related to the error handler (Ironic).

Overall, expect the new update to come out before the end of the month.

notes.title: Dream Catcher v1.3.2
notes.notes:
Today, July 18th 2023, A new update was released that significantly changes how long you can stay in the dreamscape. This was meant to be a small bugfix update but it ended up being fairly big and I think it warrants its own patchnote.

The changes include:
- Your highest level monster will now follow you in the overworld (Has no real gameplay implications, altho it represents your strongest monster which is also how enemies aggressiveness is calculated).
- Added items including healing items (allows you to stay in the dreamscape longer) and permanent stat boosting candies (persists after rebirth, allow you to better home in on your favorite evolution).
- Fixed a few bugs related to rebirthing and movesets (Ex: a creature that did not know magic spit could sometimes have it equipped after rebirthing).
- Some evolutions now require "Evil" which is a new stat that can only be gained by eating healing items.
- (This was added in v1.3.2 but was never mentioned) Enemy pathfinding is my better and spriting was rebalanced.

There are a few bugs that I am aware of. I will fix these bugs in the upcoming days. I don't have a release date for v1.4 (The new map update) but I can tell there will be at least 1 fairly big update before then as I am reworking how evolution works.

notes.title: Dream Catcher v1.3
notes.notes:
Today, July 13th 2023, A new update was released that significantly changes how you traverse the world.

The changes include:
- Redid the entire player physics to be less slippery.
- Made enemies faster than the player to make exploring high level areas rely on sneaking around.
- Added a sprint mechanic that temporarily make you faster than enemies (Your controls are more slippery while running).
- Added per-room gravity and friction so certain rooms will be more slippery and others will have lower gravity (I promise I will abuse this when designing the new map).
- Made the crash handler not almost the same size as the base game (Apparently fonts require a lot of disk space).
- There was no previous patchnote so I will add this here: If you used to crash during alpha, changes are it is fixed now. Every known crash has been fixed.

The next few updates will be about refining existing features such as enemy pathfinding in preparation for  the next major update (v1.4) which (should) be the new map (The entire map is planned to be redone from scratch if you were not aware).
